native_warning.basis: ordinary item.completed/error warning that prefer_mxc and skip_host_skill_discovery are under development; retained in original event order

input_read.basis: The sole completed native command calls File.ReadAllBytes on inputs/probe.txt, decodes the returned bytes as UTF-8 and outputs the complete original text. The result visibly returns that text with completed status and exit 0. The command includes other operations; final-byte fidelity is checked separately from the original files.

missing_feedback.basis: One ReadAllBytes request for inputs/missing-probe.txt occurs inside the same combined command. Its catch block prints MethodInvocationException with an inner FileNotFoundException and sets not_found, but the enclosing native tool result is completed/exit 0. No independent missing-file read tool or independent command has failed/error status. Program-level missing feedback is observed; E1 error-state mapping remains unknown, and the successful parent is not judged erroneous.

write_fidelity.basis: The same completed command writes echo.txt using runtime $probeBytes and receipt.json using runtime $receipt plus LF. Complete literal output payloads are absent from the command event, and an upstream [REDACTED_SECRET] marker is preserved without reconstruction. E1_write payload-to-final-byte fidelity is ineligible. The original artifact contract is assessed separately.

permission.basis: S01 normal arm has no S02 allow/deny permission metric. Observed writes complete; this supplies no S02 conditional permission conclusion.

command_and_final_byte_contract.basis: The completed command visibly requests a source-byte write to echo.txt and JSON generation with the required fields. Read-only evaluator checks on the unchanged collected native-local originals show echo bytes equal input and a valid four-field receipt. This is distinct from complete literal-payload E1_write fidelity.

artifact_checks.check_scope: read-only evaluator comparison; not product self-validation
artifact_checks.origin_note: native_local_file originals copied from the isolated participant workspace by collection; no native download was claimed

native_projection.source_location: zero-based array_index with actual received_at for every retained event
native_projection.filter: thread.started/turn.completed/turn.failed/error/warning or item.completed with command_execution/agent_message/file_change/mcp_tool_call/web_search/todo_list/error/warning; excluded payloads not emitted

limitations: Requested model and CLI version are visible; backend weights, deployment identity, hidden service state and effective effort remain unknown.
Native events are a log projection. This is not a complete independent OS audit and establishes no pure Harness causation or product-wide score.

The combined command prints a real program-level FileNotFoundException, but its enclosing tool result succeeds. No independent failed missing-read tool operation is visible, so E1 missing error-state mapping is unknown. Receipt JSON alone is a declaration.

Unchanged original artifacts support deterministic final-byte comparison; runtime-variable writes and the preserved upstream redaction prevent a complete literal-payload E1_write conclusion.
